claim: CapScan histidine-conditioned motif deviations; dots mark q<0.05 in the full 32,400-test motif family (Supplementary Fig. 13a-f)
test: paired sign-flip test of the participant mean against zero, exact (all 2^15 = 32,768 sign assignments)
n: 15 in every one of the 32,400 tests
distinct_or_repeated: repeated: acquisitions averaged within specimen, specimens within participant and region; compartment value = mean of its regions (proximal: duodenum, jejunum; distal: ileum, colon; stool), a missing region makes the participant missing
family: CapScan all_motif_positions_residues: 6 routes x 2 sides x 3 origins x 2 populations (all non-K/R; P1 = H, P1 position omitted) x flank positions x 20 residues x 3 compartments
estimate: per test: participant mean of observed minus source-expected residue frequency (Source Data column mean); 25,151 of 32,400 tests and 598 of 840 displayed cells have q < 0.05
uncertainty: per test: 95% interval in Source Data (CI95_low, CI95_high); not displayed
uncertainty_construction: percentile bootstrap of the mean, 20,000 multinomial resamples of participants
statistic: per test: |participant mean| (Source Data column mean)
exact_P: per test: Source Data column p (exact enumeration), q in column q
effect_size: per test: mean difference (fraction; x100 = percentage points, the colour scale)
effect_size_how: mean over participants of observed minus source-expected frequency of the residue at the flank position
seed: exact test: none needed; bootstrap 20261029 (20261014 + n)
software_version: CPython 3.12.4, numpy 2.2.6, pandas 2.3.3 (this recomputation); original A28 run CPython 3.10.9, numpy 1.26.4, pandas 2.3.3
